connector.name: Code Index by achreftlili
connector.registryDescription: SQLite-backed hybrid (vector + FTS) code search index for Claude Code over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-code-index. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the achreftlili account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_EMBEDDER
env.description: Embedder backend. Only 'jina' (local jina-embeddings-v2-base-code via sentence-transformers) is supported; the variable exists for future expansion.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_EMBED_MODEL
env.description: HuggingFace model id. Defaults to 'jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code'. Override only if you know the model is dim-compatible.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_EMBED_DIM
env.description: Embedding dimension. Defaults to 768 (matches jina-embeddings-v2-base-code). Must match the model's output dim.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_DB
env.description: Path to the SQLite index database. Defaults to .claude/index.db relative to the working directory.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_EMBED_BATCH
env.description: Encode batch size (default 32). Lower (e.g. 8 or 4) to reduce peak memory if the GPU OOMs on large files.

env.name: CODE_INDEX_EMBED_DEVICE
env.description: Torch device override: 'cpu', 'mps', or 'cuda'. Unset = auto-detect. Set 'cpu' to avoid Apple-Silicon MPS out-of-memory errors.
